title: canary-rollout-scratchpad-jamie-park
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal scratchpad for the upcoming canary rollout of rwd-llama-7b-v2 (quantized) on hosted-api. Capture the plan, checks, rollback criteria, and open questions. This is informal — will move to a proper playbook once we lock the plan.

Context:
- Release: rwd-llama-7b-v2-quant (primary model for customer-facing chat flows)
- Target deploy window: 2025-02-21 09:00 - 12:00 PT (low traffic region of day)
- Why canary: new quant kernels + KV cache optimization; risk of latency regressions and rare tokenization edge-cases.

High-level rollout steps:
1) Pre-check (30m before): confirm infra health, GPU availability, autoscaler paused for canary pool, config pinned.
2) Canary 1: 1% traffic -> run for 30–45m.
3) Canary 2: 5% traffic -> run 60m.
4) Canary 3: 25% traffic -> run 90m.
5) Ramp to 100% if all checks pass, or pause/rollback at any stop.

Traffic routing details:
- Use smart-routing policy: route by endpoint tag "chat-v2". Only the hosted-api pool gets canary until dedicated approved.
- Version pin: config "model_version": "rwd-llama-7b-v2-quant@2025-02-20" in rollout config. Ensure fallback policy points to rwd-llama-7b-v1 (non-quant) if runtime error >= 0.5%

Monitoring & success signals (per-canary window):
- Error rate (500/5xx) <= 0.3% (absolute) AND no >50% increase vs baseline.
- Model quality: compare sampled completions against golden prompt set (quick eval): BLEU/ROUGE not ideal, but check for token-level divergence and missing completions. Manual spot checks (10 prompts) every window.
- Latency: P95 <= 1.2s and P99 <= 2.5s for chat-v2 route. If P95 increases >30% vs baseline, flag.
- Cost: tokens/usd for canary should not exceed baseline by >20% (expect lower with quant, but watch batching behavior).
- Observability: no spike in KV cache misses, no increase in GPU OOM or kernel fallback logs.

Dashboards & queries to run (placeholders):
- Console: /dashboards/chat-v2/latency-and-errors
- Trace: sampling for canary session_ids (tag = canary-jamie-20250221)
- Quick metrics: 
  * errors_pct = sum(errors, 5m)/sum(requests,5m)
  * p95_latency = histogram_percentile(latency_ms, 95)
  * kv_cache_miss_rate = cache_misses/ cache_lookups
- Sentry: search for new stacktraces from serving-runtime in last 1h filtered by release tag v2-quant.

Rollback criteria (immediate actions):
- Error rate > 0.5% absolute OR >100% increase vs baseline -> immediate rollback to pinned fallback (v1) and page SRE.
- P95 latency > 1.8s for 2 consecutive 5m windows -> pause rollout, investigate kernel selection and batching.
- Manual quality alert: if 3/10 sampled prompts show major regression (missing content, tokenization issues) -> rollback and run local reproducer.
- GPU OOM or serving-runtime panic -> immediate rollback and open incident.

Post-rollback steps:
- Capture traces and logs for last 30m; tag with "canary-failed-jamie-20250221".
- Run local reproducer against same model binary and host config.
- File postmortem (templated) within 48h.

Staging verifications (done pre-canary):
- Smoke tests: end-to-end chat flows with 20 prompts (edge cases included).
- Load test: 200 rps for 10m against canary pool, watch latency percentiles and CPU/GPU.
- Kernel logs: ensure no fallback to slow path more than 1% of calls.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Who will run manual spot checks during Canary 2 and 3? (Pinged Olivia for 5% window.)
- Add quick golden-set auto-eval to the canary pipeline? (JIRA-RWD-842: add basic eval job)
- Confirm autoscaler behavior: should be paused for the first two canaries, then re-enabled at 25%? Ops opinion needed.
- Ensure billing tags attached to canary traffic to measure cost separately (billing tag = canary/jamie/20250221).
- Confirm that dedicated customers will not be affected (they should be pinned to v1 unless explicitly updated).

Communications plan:
- Pre-rollout Slack: #releases + #oncall SRE 15m before start with traffic URL and canary tag.
- During rollout: status updates at each ramp stage in Slack + short note in the rollout thread 
- Post-rollout: update Confluence page and notify product owners + customer success if any changes to expected behavior.

Notes to self:
- Keep a small sample of failing requests (if any) and mark with reason: OOM / latency / bad output.
- If we see hallucination spike, correlate with prompt type and length — might be quantization edge-case.
- Remember to unpause autoscaler if we do full rollout (ops will remind, but add as check).

Quick checklist (checkbox style in doc):
- [ ] Tag release binary: rwd-llama-7b-v2-quant@2025-02-20
- [ ] Pin model_version in routing config
- [ ] Pause autoscaler for canary pool (Ops)
- [ ] Create canary traffic tag and billing tag
- [ ] Start Canary 1 (1%) and run smoke checks
- [ ] Run golden-set eval after each window
- [ ] Decision point at each ramp (go/hold/rollback)

Extras (dev notes):
- Reproducer command: ./local_repro.sh --model rwd-llama-7b-v2-quant --host canary-host-03 --prompt-file sample-edge-cases.txt
- Kernel flag: set RWD_KERNEL_DEBUG=1 if investigating quant rounding anomalies (beware perf impact).

End of scratchpad. Will tidy and move to confluence once we confirm slot/time and Ops sign-off.
